head_commit.message:
fix(tool): name every McpCli HXW004 cause and its remedy

The HXW004 refusal for an McpCli run said only that the mapped checkout was
uninitialized or had no tool project, and its hint said only to initialize
the checkout. That did not help when the checkout was initialized at a commit
without src/Hexalith.McpCli/Hexalith.McpCli.csproj, or when the project
resolved through a link outside the checkout. The reason now names all three
causes, and the hint asks for a commit whose tool project lies inside the
checkout.

Add a test that the McpCli build refuses a missing or altered pinned catalog
before any build process starts, matching the Platform model build's drift
cases. The README no longer claims that test builds McpCli: test needs
--profile naming a declared test, and the McpCli declaration has none, so it
refuses with HXC002 and builds nothing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
